cells.gaps: No fact shows the local tax module past its pilot outside Bamako: the 680 communes are ReCoDe deployed for testing with the tax module's use not stated (MLI-007), the same note says only Kava was willing to carry it through and recommends a pilot phase (MLI-008), and Salen and Koutiala are one-commune tests. Held is disputed, shared at the DGCT for 13 communes (MLI-005) against local (MLI-006, MLI-014) and paper for market fees (MLI-012); owner is the ministry for ReCoDe (MLI-009) and a partner for the Koutiala project, and no plan is stated.
cells.note: The register exists only in tests and pilots: Bamako Commune VI, Koulikoro, Kava, and Koutiala from March 2026. Stage 3 needs a system past its pilot and live in local governments outside the capital, and a count deployed for testing is not that.
